description: Spears and axes at distance - bleeds that stack and a throw that keeps coming back.
_source_note: Rebuilt 6 Nov 2026 from the 33 real CoA Headhunting talents (role DPS, thrown). Energy is the whole pool on both sides, so the cost and refund talents need no translation. Six CoA talents hang off Born in Blood, a buff we do not have and whose per-tick resource restore would need a periodic trigger that does not exist; they collapse into two nodes granting health and energy on a real trigger. Brutality owns the class execute threshold.

nodes.name: Strong Arm
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your spears by 25% and your hit chance by 6%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage of Spears by 15% and your hit chance by 3%.' PORTS EXACTLY, doubled. 'SPEARS' IS A CoA ABILITY CATEGORY AND THE ENGINE HAS NO SUCH CONCEPT - there is no ability-group key - so all five spear abilities are written out individually. That matters: a single ability_barbarian_spears_* key would have been silent dead data, since the lookup is ability_<exact id>_damage. hit_rating is live as a FLAT bonus in PERCENTAGE POINTS; it is only invalid as a CONVERSION target. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Gruesome
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Throw Weapon, Gutspiller and Berserker Axe by 10.8%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases the damage of Throw Weapon, Gutspiller, and Guts Spilled by 10%.' Doubled for the two ranks. Guts Spilled is a SUB-EFFECT of Gutspiller in CoA (its every-6-seconds bleed-out) with no separate ability id here, so it has no handle of its own - Berserker Axe takes its place as the spec's third throw. CoA's Payback ('increases the damage dealt by your Guts Spilled by 75%') fails the same way and is folded in as part of this 20%. All FRACTIONS. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Guts Splatter
nodes.description: Increases your armor penetration by 120.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Your Gutspiller now allows your abilities to ignore 10% of the enemy's Armor.' The conditional ('while Gutspiller is on the target') cannot be built - nothing reads a target's debuffs - and armor_penetration is FLAT rather than proportional, so '10% of the enemy's Armor' has no expressible form: there is no armor_pen_pct key and inventing one would have been silent. Built as a flat 120 rating, unconditional. Folded in CoA's Hunting for Sport ('while Unbridled Rage is active, your attacks now ignore 20% of the target's Armor'), which fails on both halves for the same reasons plus a third: nothing reads whether another effect is live. armor_penetration IS live (monster.py:659, via _pen_flat). A FLAT RATING. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: To The Bone
nodes.description: Your attacks have a 35% chance to break the target's defenses, lowering their armor for 4 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the critical strike chance of Guts Spilled by 10% and it now applies Break to the target and critically striking with it will apply an additional stack. Break: break an enemy's defenses, reducing their armor by -4% for 30 seconds, stacking 5 times.' The Break debuff ports with CoA's 5 stacks; Guts Spilled has no ability id of its own to scope either the crit or the trigger to, and the extra-stack-on-crit clause would need the proc to know it crit. `armor` on a monster is FLAT (Monster.armor is base_armor plus the status mod), so CoA's '-4%' becomes -150 per stack, -750 at five. 30 sec -> 4 turns. armor is one of only eight status stat_mods a monster reads.

nodes.name: Puncture Wounds
nodes.description: Your critical strikes open a bleed dealing damage over 3 turns, stacking up to 3 times.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Critical strikes with Spears now causes enemies to bleed for 6 sec.' PORTS ALMOST VERBATIM; only the Spears scoping goes (no per-ability proc trigger, and 'Spears' is not an engine category anyway - see Strong Arm). 6 sec -> 3 turns, with 3 stacks added since this spec applies bleeds from four directions. A proc-applied dot carries `potency` as PER-TURN damage - 28 a turn, 84 per stack, 252 at three - where an ABILITY rank's effect_value is the TOTAL across the duration and gets divided (abilities.py:2695). Note dot_duration_pct does NOT reach a proc-applied dot: it is read in the ability dot branch, not the proc payload path.

nodes.name: Spear Thrower
nodes.description: Your ranged attacks have a 30% chance to reset the cooldown of Headhunter's Spear.
nodes._source: CoA level 30 passive: 'Casting Throw Weapon now has a 30% chance to reset the cooldown of your Spears.' PORTS ALMOST VERBATIM, chance included. reset_cooldown WITH A BARE LIST is a full reset, as against the {abilities, turns} form which only shaves turns. Scoped to Headhunter's Spear rather than all five spears: it is the one that generates Energy (25), so resetting it feeds the rotation, and resetting five cooldowns at once off a 30% swing proc would be the whole spec.

nodes.name: Furious Berserker
nodes.description: Your critical strikes restore 12 Energy and heal you.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Critical strikes with Barbed Spear now grants Born in Blood. Born in Blood: battle fuels your vitality, restoring 18 health and 12 Energy over 3 seconds.' CoA hangs this on BORN IN BLOOD, a buff that does not exist in our ability data - and whose own text ('restoring 18 health and 12 Energy over 3 seconds') is a HoT plus a per-tick resource grant, which would need a periodic trigger the engine does not have. Six Headhunting talents depend on it; they are collapsed into direct grants on live triggers. So the grant becomes immediate rather than a HoT, with CoA's exact 12 Energy and a flat heal. One proc can carry both a grant_resource and a heal_flat, which is why this one node does both halves. Folded in CoA's Vengeance For Zul'jin, which grants the same buff off Berserker Rush. grant_resource's `amount` is FLAT; there is no percentage-of-maximum form.

nodes.name: Frothing Savage
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your spears and Berserker Axe by 16%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases the critical strike chance of Spears and Berserker Axe by 8% against bleeding targets.' The crit ports (doubled) but THE CONDITION DOES NOT: nothing reads whether a target is bleeding, or carries any other debuff, which also cost Ranger's Serrations and Corrosive Poison and Necromancer's Fiend their conditionals. Kept unconditional rather than shipping something that silently never fires. Written per ability because 'Spears' is a CoA category with no engine equivalent. Per-ability crit keys are PERCENTAGE POINTS. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Deep Fury
nodes.description: Your attacks have a 35% chance to reduce the cooldown of Unbridled Rage and Axe Twirling by 2 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Direct Physical damage dealt now reduces the cooldown of Unbridled Rage by -1 sec.' PORTS ALMOST EXACTLY - the {abilities, turns} form of reset_cooldown shaves turns rather than resetting outright, which is what CoA describes. Extended to Axe Twirling from CoA's Time To Kill! ('reduces the cooldown of Axe Twirling by -15 sec'). 1 sec -> 2 turns, since a sub-turn reduction would round to nothing.

nodes.name: Payback
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Gutspiller and Impaling Spear by 40% and your periodic damage by 15%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage dealt by your Guts Spilled by 75%.' Guts Spilled is a SUB-EFFECT of Gutspiller with no ability id of its own, so the buff lands on the parent dot and on Impaling Spear, the spec's other dot, with dot_damage covering the periodic half globally. dot_damage is the global periodic key (abilities.py:1601) and reaches Storm of Steel too. 75% split across two abilities plus a global rather than stacked on one. All FRACTIONS. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: No Survivors
nodes.description: Increases the duration of Maiming Spear, Barbed Spear and Gutspiller by 2 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the duration of Axe Twirling, Maiming Spear, and Barbed Spear by 5 sec.' 5 sec -> 2 turns. Barbed Spear is a ranged_damage ability with no duration and Axe Twirling is a self-buff, so Gutspiller and Impaling Spear - the spec's two dots - take their place, where the extension is worth far more: +2 TURNS ON A DOT ADDS TICKS AT FULL PER-TURN VALUE, because abilities.py:2777 derives per_turn from the ability's OWN base duration rather than the talented one. Both go 3 -> 5 turns and their totals rise by two thirds. Maiming Spear keeps its extension as a debuff. SMALL INTEGERS IN TURNS, so talent_ranks.spread() refuses to rank this node - correct, since a third of a turn per rank reads as nothing. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Berserker
nodes.description: Your critical strikes have a 30% chance to throw an extra Berserker Axe.
nodes._source: CoA: 'While enraged, your ranged critical strikes now grant you Berserker. Berserker: your ranged abilities have a 20% chance to unleash Berserker Throw, dealing 75% Ranged Weapon Damage. While active, every offensive ranged ability used increases its chance to trigger by 2%.' THREE LAYERS, ONE SURVIVES: 'while enraged' reads whether an effect is live, the escalating chance needs a counter, and a proc that grants a proc-carrying buff would be a nested proc the audit cannot inspect. Built as the payoff directly - a cast_ability proc firing Berserker Axe, which costs nothing when it fires. Berserker Axe is ungated, so cast_ability's known failure mode (it does not check the caster has learned the ability) cannot bite here. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Raging Spirit
nodes.description: Reduces the cost of all your abilities by 15% and increases your ranged attack power by 20% of your Agility.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Casting Unbridled Rage now grants you 30 Energy and it now also removes the Energy cost of your Spirit spells while active.' The grant needs a per-ability proc trigger and the cost waiver needs both an active-effect read and a 'Spirit spells' category, none of which exist - and nothing waives a cost outright. So it becomes a flat cost reduction, which is the reliable version of the same intent. Folded in CoA's Power Tosser ('damage dealt by Throw Weapon now scales with your Agility') as a real conversion: ranged_ap is in STAT_CONVERSION_TARGETS and agility in SOURCES, a legal pair that reaches every ranged ability rather than one. all_ability_cost_pct is a FRACTION where POSITIVE MEANS A REDUCTION; the conversion key is a fraction too.

nodes.name: Power Tosser
nodes.description: Increases your ranged attack power by a further 25% of your Agility and your critical damage by 25%.
nodes._source: CoA level 50 passive: 'Damage dealt by Throw Weapon now scales with your Agility.' Built as the conversion rather than a per-ability scaling coefficient, which no key reaches - the ability keys are _damage, _healing, _crit, _crit_damage, _cost, _cooldown, _duration and _potency, and none touch how an ability scales off a stat. Stacks with Raging Spirit to 45% of Agility as ranged attack power, which is this spec's whole stat identity. crit_damage_pct is read at abilities.py:1438 and is a FRACTION, as is the conversion key.

nodes.name: Skullseeker
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 8%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your critical strike chance against enemies above 80% health by 25%.' CoA gates this on the target being ABOVE 80% health. high_health_damage_threshold_pct is DEAD DATA and there is no above-health conditional of any kind - only the below-health low_health_damage_pct added 6 Nov 2026 - so the condition is dropped and 25% cut to 8% precisely because it is now unconditional and permanent where CoA's applies only to opening hits. Brutality carries a node of the same name and CoA's own data has it twice, which is why the values differ: each is priced for its own tree. crit_chance_physical is PERCENTAGE POINTS. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Axe Twirling
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Axe Twirling by 40% and increases your area damage by 20%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Display mastery over throwing weapons for 10 sec, causing Throw Weapon, Gutspiller, and Berserker Axe to strike 2 additional nearby enemies.' The ability already exists as a 3-turn self-buff. NOTHING ADDS TARGETS TO AN ABILITY - no effect key and no proc payload touches an ability's target count, which also killed Spear Shards, Impaling Spear's shatter, Spite's multi-throw and Ranger's Wild Man - so the intent lands as aoe_damage, which IS live and is read at abilities.py:1600 only when target_type is enemy_aoe, so it is genuinely scoped to area attacks. Folded in CoA's Time To Kill! ('reduces the cooldown of Axe Twirling by -15 sec'), which names the same ability.

nodes.name: Manhunter
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 5% and your physical damage by 8%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases critical strike chance of all party and raid members by 3%. Does not stack with similar effects. In addition, increases your damage dealt by 10% against Humanoids.' NEITHER HALF SURVIVES AS WRITTEN: a talent effect can never reach an ally, and Barbarian has no 'Manhunter' ABILITY to convert to target_type 'party' the way Ancestry's eight auras already are; and NOTHING READS A CREATURE TYPE - no effect key or proc condition inspects a monster's family, which also cost Ranger's Windrunner's Reach its text. So both become selfish and unconditional. crit_chance_physical is PERCENTAGE POINTS; physical_damage is a FRACTION.

nodes.name: Brutal Form
nodes.description: Increases the healing of Ancestral Roar and Savage Revelry by 15.9%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the tick rate of Born in Blood by 25%, allows its healing to scale with your Agility, and it can now critically heal you.' THREE CLAUSES, NONE BUILDABLE: Born in Blood does not exist as an ability here; tick rate is meaningless when an effect ticks once per turn; and a HoT's ticks never roll crit in this engine, with no key to allow it (CoA asks for that repeatedly - Necromancer's Impeccable Timing, Reaper's Lacerations, Ranger's Bleeding Edge - and it fails every time). Re-pointed to the class's two real heals. BOTH TAKE ability_<id>_HEALING, not _damage: Ancestral Roar and Savage Revelry are effect_type heal, and _damage on a heal passes every check while doing nothing, which is how 18 talents across four classes were silently dead before _healing was accepted. Both FRACTIONS.

nodes.name: Spite
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Spite and Javelin Toss by 35% and reduces Spite's cooldown by 30%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Quickly unleash 3 Berserker Throws at your target and then fling yourself back a great distance, dealing 125% Ranged Weapon Damage, scaling with modifiers to Berserker Axe.' The ability already exists on an 8-turn cooldown. Its multi-throw cannot be built (nothing adds attacks or targets to an ability) and the reposition has no positioning to use, so the node boosts it and Javelin Toss directly. Folded in CoA's Sen'jin's Guidance, which transforms Throw Weapon into Javelin Toss - nothing transforms one ability into another - so its crit clause lands here as damage instead. *_cooldown_pct is a FRACTION where POSITIVE MEANS A REDUCTION; the damage keys are fractions too but add rather than subtract.

nodes.name: Gurubashi Technique
nodes.description: Your ranged attacks have a 25% chance to throw a second weapon, and your periodic damage is increased by 20%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Casting Throw Weapon now has a 25% chance to transform your next cast of it within 8 sec into Rapid Throw.' NOTHING TRANSFORMS ONE ABILITY INTO ANOTHER - that killed Sen'jin's Guidance too, and Felsworn's Fel Torpedo - so the 25% chance is kept and cashed as a free extra Throw Weapon instead, which is what Rapid Throw amounts to. cast_ability takes a bare ability id and costs nothing when it fires; Throw Weapon is ungated, so cast_ability's known failure mode cannot bite. The dot_damage half ties the capstone to the bleed theme Puncture Wounds, Payback and No Survivors build, stacking with Payback to +35%.
